newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO in Thai steel joint venture.
newsitem.headline: POSCO in Thai steel joint venture.

text.p: South Korea's Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd (POSCO) said on Friday it had started building a joint venture steel plant in Ban Pakong, 57 km southeast of Bangkok, Thailand.

A POSCO spokesman said $10 million would be invested in the POS/Thai Steel Service Center, which was expected to be completed by early 1998. It would have an annual production capacity of 120,000 tonnes of cold-rolled steel products.
POSCO has an 18.5 percent stake in the plant and its subsidiary, Posco Steel Service and Sales Co Ltd (POSTEEL), has 19.5 percent, the spokesman said.
Samsung Corp has 27 percent, Daewoo Corp has 15 percent, Hyosung Corp has 15 percent and Siam Steel Pipe Group has five percent, he said.
The spokesman said the steel service center would provide auto makers and home appliance makers with custom-made cold-rolled steel products.
